facts.fact: Gambiana reports the government has suspended ID card issuance so databases can be reviewed and synchronised before a new national identification management system, run under a public-private partnership with Margins ID Group, launches on 29 June 2026.
facts.system: New identification management system (Margins ID Group PPP)
